high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Wired.com, viewed on a mobile device. The time displayed at the top of the screen is 8:04, and the device is connected to a 5G network with a partially charged battery. The article discusses a graduation speech given by Steve Jobs at Stanford University. The text mentions that the audience seemed to be listening politely, but some were distracted due to the heat. Porter, one of the copresidents, was particularly distracted, spending much of his time drinking water and looking for more.
